title: Demo: Follow-up tracker and meeting recap automation for High Scale
summary: A sample of how routine virtual-assistant work could be automated: meeting recaps with action items, deadline follow-ups in Slack, and a cross-team task view. Sample data only.

scenes.heading: Meeting recap to tracked follow-ups
scenes.caption: Shows how a meeting summary could turn into tasks and reminders without manual copying between tools.

steps.label: Meeting ends on calendar
steps.detail: A Google Calendar event ending triggers the workflow and pulls in the attendee list and any notes doc.

steps.label: Draft recap with an LLM
steps.detail: Notes are summarized into decisions and action items with an owner and due date for each.
steps.on_error: If notes are empty, a Slack message asks the organizer to paste notes and the run waits.

steps.label: Human review
steps.detail: The assistant or executive approves or edits the recap in a short form before anything is sent.
steps.on_error: If nobody approves within 4 hours, a reminder is sent and nothing goes out.

steps.label: Create tasks in ClickUp
steps.detail: Each approved action item becomes a task with owner, due date and a link to the recap.
steps.on_error: If an owner cannot be matched, the task is put in a Needs Owner list and flagged in Slack.

steps.label: Send recap and schedule reminders
steps.detail: The recap is emailed and posted to Slack; reminders are scheduled for the day before each due date.
steps.on_error: On a failed send, the run retries twice, then alerts the assistant with the draft attached.

scenes.heading: Slack follow-up nudges
scenes.caption: Shows a bot chasing a pending item and updating the tracker from the reply.

messages.text: Reminder: Task 'Send revised storyboard to Acme Beauty' is due tomorrow. Owner: Jane Sample.
Hi Jane, the storyboard for Acme Beauty is due tomorrow at 5 PM PT. Is it on track?
Slightly behind. Need until Friday morning.
Understood. I will move the due date to Friday 10 AM PT and let the account lead know. Okay to send that note?
Due date updated in the tracker. Note posted to #acme-beauty-campaign. Change logged.

scenes.heading: Cross-team deliverables tracker
scenes.caption: Shows one view of deadlines across creative, production and leadership, with overdue items flagged.

scenes.heading: Weekly operations view
scenes.caption: Shows summary tiles over open items so a lead can see what needs attention in one glance.

assumptions: Assumed the team uses Google Calendar, Slack and ClickUp, since the post lists them as examples.
Assumed meeting notes exist as a doc or transcript the workflow can read.
Assumed a person approves every recap and message before it goes out.
Assumed this supports a human assistant rather than replacing the role.
Assumed deadlines are kept in a single tracker such as ClickUp.
